title: A headless worker is refused git worktree add, which its role file forbids and the shared allow rules permit
goal: agents/worker.md rule 2 says a worker never runs git worktree add, while .claude/settings.json allows Bash(git worktree add *) for every session, the orchestrator's included (found by the ST-4jbvwssm worker, SP-mujl7ebh); a worker that runs it is refused by a hook or by the settings dispatch gives it, and the orchestrator keeps the rule. The settings change is the operator's.

run:
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import backlog, bl_cli, bl_dispatch
from bl_base import load_settings
root = bl_cli.default_root(backlog.ROOT)
load_settings(root)
bl = backlog.Backlog(root)
iid = next(i for i in sorted(bl.items) if bl.items[i].get("kind") == "story")
argv = bl_dispatch.claude_argv(bl, iid)
joined = " ".join(argv)
assert "worktree add" in joined and ("--disallowedTools" in argv or "--settings" in argv), "the worker session argv carries no refusal of git worktree add: " + joined[:200]
